$comment: Single source of truth for committed agent evals. Adding an eval = create workers/main/tests/evals/<id>.test.ts (gated on RUN_AGENT_EVALS, ending in emitEvalTranscript from ./eval-transcript) and add one entry here. Each entry requires kind: unit checks one mechanism; skill checks end-to-end agent ability. Scorecard point budgets should be unit 1-5 pts, skill 6-20 pts scaled to task complexity; pass/fail criteria remain the hard contract. Consumed by scripts/run-agent-eval.mjs and scripts/run-eval-suite.sh. custom-prompt-live is intentionally NOT listed — it's the generic env-driven custom-prompt harness, not a fixed eval. realDeploy:true marks evals that only run when real deploy is enabled (CF_API_TOKEN + EVAL_REAL_DEPLOY!=0).
